purpose: Reusable generation prompt archive for THOUSAND assets
provenance: Transcribed without prompt changes from the existing generation record, not reconstructed from appearance.
reproduction_note: Use the exact prompt, references and transparency option together. Identical outputs are not guaranteed. Model and seed were not recorded and remain null. Preserve the approved PNGs for exact reuse.
history_gaps: Discarded early banana variants are mentioned in the original record, but their exact prompts and outputs are not preserved here. Do not invent them.
future_recording_rule: For every generated image and revision, record prompt verbatim, tool, available model/settings, reference paths and hashes, date, output path/hash, status and relationship to previous versions. Record edits and rejected variants without overwriting prior prompts.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a bespoke photorealistic website cutout based on reference product. Subject: A whole cheese blueberry pie with rustic fluted golden pastry crust, deep purple berry filling, billowy ivory cream generously marbled with purple blueberry sauce and fresh dark blueberries, closely matching reference. No slice removed. One intact whole round pie ONLY. Genuine transparent alpha PNG. Absolutely no backdrop, no gradients, no glow, no floor, no shadow outside the silhouette, no plate, tin, utensils, packaging, people or text. Center the entire pie within transparent margins with nothing cropped. Matching eight-asset set: camera three-quarter front view 25 degrees above horizontal, soft warm upper-left studio light, highly realistic pastry and filling texture. Object occupies 75 percent of canvas width and about 55 percent height. Clean sharp cutout edges. No baked checkerboard. ONLY THE PIE, FULLY TRANSPARENT SURROUNDINGS.
assets.postprocessing: No pixel edits recorded; copied as independent runtime asset.
